scope_note: High-confidence Arabic findings from ranks 516 onward.

arabic.current_english: I don't come here very often.
arabic.issue: unnormalized adverbial tanwin
arabic.proposed_english: I don't come here very often.

arabic.current_english: I don't even know anybody there.
arabic.issue: English emphatic 'even' is absent from target
arabic.proposed_target: لا أعرف حتى أي شخص هناك.
arabic.proposed_english: I don't even know anybody there.

arabic.current_english: I don't know what it means.
arabic.issue: تعني without an explicit neuter antecedent is person/gender ambiguous and does not cleanly match English 'it'
arabic.proposed_english: I don't know what it means.

arabic.current_english: I have to go the bathroom.
arabic.issue: Arabic typo عليي and ungrammatical English missing 'to'
arabic.proposed_english: I have to go to the bathroom.

arabic.current_english: I hope your brother is better.
arabic.issue: ungrammatical أن-clause
arabic.proposed_target: آمل أن يكون أخوك قد تحسن.
arabic.proposed_english: I hope your brother is better.

arabic.current_english: I must have my watch repaired.
arabic.issue: malformed passive-purpose construction
arabic.proposed_english: I must have my watch repaired.

arabic.current_target: ما كان يجب علي أن أخبرك بكل شيء
arabic.current_english: I shouldn't have told you anything.
arabic.issue: بكل شيء means everything, not anything under the intended reading
arabic.proposed_target: ما كان يجب عليّ أن أخبرك بكل شيء.
arabic.proposed_english: I shouldn't have told you everything.

arabic.current_english: I was made to go there.
arabic.issue: missing preposition إلى with destination
arabic.proposed_english: I was made to go there.

arabic.current_english: I would like a tourist visa.
arabic.issue: missing initial hamza and incorrect punctuation spacing
arabic.proposed_english: I would like a tourist visa.

arabic.current_english: I wouldn't know how to begin.
arabic.issue: target is indicative present/future, not conditional
arabic.proposed_english: I don't know how I'll begin.

arabic.current_target: فضلا، أيمكنني الحصول على كوب قهوة آخر؟
arabic.current_english: Could I have one more coffee, please?
arabic.issue: unnormalized فضلًا spelling
arabic.proposed_target: فضلًا، أيمكنني الحصول على كوب قهوة آخر؟
arabic.proposed_english: Could I have one more coffee, please?

arabic.current_target: هل تريد أن تنصحني بشيء ما ؟
arabic.current_english: Do you have any advice for me?
arabic.issue: target asks whether the addressee wants to advise, not whether they have advice; bad punctuation spacing
arabic.proposed_english: Do you have any advice for me?

arabic.current_target: كل ما عليك القيام به هو الإنتظار.
arabic.current_english: All you need to do is wait.
arabic.issue: incorrect hamza spelling in الانتظار
arabic.proposed_target: كل ما عليك القيام به هو الانتظار.
arabic.proposed_english: All you need to do is wait.

arabic.current_english: I cannot tell how this is done.
arabic.issue: this/that mismatch and unnatural English rendering of لا أعرف
arabic.proposed_english: I don't know how that is done.

arabic.current_target: أنا حتى لا أعرف ما ذلك.
arabic.current_english: I don't even know what that is.
arabic.issue: unnatural Arabic placement of حتى
arabic.proposed_target: أنا لا أعرف حتى ما ذلك.
arabic.proposed_english: I don't even know what that is.

arabic.current_target: لا أرغب في بتناول أي طعامٍ اليوم.
arabic.current_english: I don't feel like eating anything today.
arabic.issue: duplicated prepositional element في بــ makes target ungrammatical
arabic.proposed_target: لا أرغب في تناول أي طعام اليوم.
arabic.proposed_english: I don't feel like eating anything today.

arabic.current_english: I don't have time to eat now.
arabic.issue: missing hamzas in للأكل and الآن
arabic.proposed_english: I don't have time to eat now.

arabic.current_english: I don't know what to do tomorrow.
arabic.issue: awkward literal structure and inconsistent diacritics
arabic.proposed_english: I don't know what to do tomorrow.

arabic.current_target: لا أعرف أين توجد نظاراتي الشمسية
arabic.current_english: I don't know where my sunglasses are.
arabic.issue: missing terminal punctuation
arabic.proposed_target: لا أعرف أين توجد نظاراتي الشمسية.
arabic.proposed_english: I don't know where my sunglasses are.

arabic.current_target: أشك في أن يستطيع أحد فعل ذلك.
arabic.current_english: I don't think anybody could do that.
arabic.issue: unnatural subject placement inside أن-clause
arabic.proposed_target: أشك في أن أحدًا يستطيع فعل ذلك.
arabic.proposed_english: I don't think anybody could do that.
